title: Powering up with governance: the AI revolution in utilities
summary: The utility industry is facing a critical point where it must embrace the vast potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to transform energy production and distribution while addressing significant concerns related to regulations, data security, and ethical considerations. This juncture requires careful guidance from utility leaders to navigate the AI challenges and opportunities ahead. How does one harness the transformative power of AI while safeguarding an ethical, responsible, and sustainable future?
